column1: Whisk the flour, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl.
Beat the butter and brown sugar on medium-high about 3 minutes until creamy.
Beat in the egg, then the maple syrup, vanilla, and maple extract.
Mix in the dry ingredients on low, then add the pecans.
Cover and chill the dough at least 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C) and line baking sheets with parchment or silicone mats.
Roll the dough into balls of about 1.5 tbsp and space them 3 inches apart.
Bake 12–13 minutes until the edges are set and lightly browned but the centers look soft.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheets, then move to a rack to cool completely.
For the icing, melt the butter with the maple syrup over low heat, then whisk in the confectioners' sugar and salt.
Drizzle the icing over the cooled cookies and let it set about 1 hour.
